mods.name: MP3-Player
mods.description: In-game MP3-Player & placeable 3D Boombox (MP3, M4A, Opus, WAV, FLAC & OGG) with modern GUI, Minecraft Sound Options volume slider, and Essential-compatible Opus 3D spatial audio.

releases.notes:
### Highlights (`v1.2.0` — Boombox & Sound Options Update)
- **Added Placeable 3D Boombox Block & Item (`mp3player:boombox`):**
  - Craftable Survival stereo Boombox (`Iron Ingots`, `Redstone`, `Note Blocks`, `Gold Ingot`, `Planks`) available in Creative under *Tools & Utilities* and *Functional Blocks*.
  - Custom 3D stereo cabinet + top carrying handle model, directional placement (`FACING`), glowing active LED equalizer display (`playing=true`) with floating musical note particles, and automatic item drop when broken.
  - **World-Anchored 3D Positional Audio:** Plays true 3D directional OpenAL audio (`AL_LINEAR_DISTANCE_CLAMPED` up to 56 blocks) directly from the placed Boombox's block coordinates `(x + 0.5, y + 0.5, z + 0.5)` — audible in 3D **both to the owner and to all nearby players** across Singleplayer, LAN, Essential Mod World Hosting, and Dedicated Fabric Servers across all 6 formats (`.mp3`, `.m4a`, `.opus`, `.wav`, `.flac`, `.ogg`).
  - Right-click any placed Boombox to open the Boombox GUI (select tracks, transfer active playback to/from Headphones, or see who is currently playing on it); `Shift + Right-Click` (empty hand) for quick Play/Pause; breaking the block immediately stops playback for everyone.
- **Added Native Volume Slider in Minecraft's Sound Options (`SoundOptionsScreen`):**
  - Injects a full-width **`MP3 & Boombox`** slider (`OFF` – `100%`) directly inside Minecraft's **Options → Music & Sounds...** menu using Fabric `ScreenEvents` (**0 Mixins**).
  - Controls all local MP3-Player, Boombox, and incoming 3D speaker audio volumes independently of `Master Volume` with live real-time gain updates and automatic persistence in `config/mp3player.properties`.

> **Requirements:** Minecraft `26.2`, Fabric Loader `>= 0.20.1`, Fabric API (`26.2`), Java `25+`

releases.notes:
### Highlights (`v1.1.0` — Multi-Format Audio Update)
- **Added Native Multi-Format Audio Support (`.m4a`, `.opus`, `.wav`, `.flac`, `.ogg`, `.mp3`):**
  - **`.m4a`** — MP4 / AAC-LC / HE-AAC (`JAAD 0.9.4`, iTunes metadata & `O(1)` MP4 sample-table seeking)
  - **`.opus`** — Ogg Opus (`Concentus 1.0.1`, `OpusTags` Vorbis Comments, pre-skip & Q7.8 output gain, `O(1)` page seeking)
  - **`.wav`** — 8/16/24/32-bit Linear PCM & 32/64-bit IEEE Float (`LIST`/`INFO` tags & exact frame-aligned seeking)
  - **`.flac`** — Lossless 8–32 bit FLAC (`jFLAC 1.5.2`, `VorbisComment` metadata & `SeekTable` / frame-sync seeking)
  - **`.ogg`** — Ogg Vorbis & Ogg Opus (`JOrbis` + automatic codec sniffing & `O(1)` page seeking)
- **Upgraded 3D Spatial Multiplayer & Essential Mod Streaming to 48 kHz Pure-Java Opus:**
  - Broadcasts **all 6 audio formats** live in **3D Speaker Mode** at `~8 KB/s` (`64 kbps` inside `<= 4 KB` packets) in 1:1 hardware-clock lockstep with local OpenAL playback — supporting instant headerless mid-song joining, live mode switching, and synchronized seeking.
- **Hi-Fi GUI Improvements:**
  - Color-coded format badges (`MP3`, `M4A`, `OPUS`, `WAV`, `FLAC`, `OGG`), format search filtering, and Drag & Drop import for all 6 formats.

> **Requirements:** Minecraft `26.2`, Fabric Loader `>= 0.20.1`, Fabric API (`26.2`), Java `25+`
